title: A hurricane is NOT headed for LA County—but the beaches will be impacted over Labor Day weekend
description: No—a hurricane is not going to make landfall in LA County. But National Weather Service meteorologist Dr. Ariel Cohen says we may see impacts along the coast including large swells and extremely dangerous rip currents. If the beach is part of your Labor Day plans, check in with a LA County Lifeguard before entering the water, know your limits, and always swim or surf in front of an open lifeguard tower.
